text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "A unique and innovative energy solution has been in operation in Frauenfeld (TG) since autumn 2024: the SeasON sorption storage heat pump, developed by the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU) and Matica AG from Kaltenbach in the canton of Thurgau.", "gist": "A new energy solution called SeasON is operating in Frauenfeld since autumn 2024, developed by HSLU and Matica AG."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "SeasON's catchy slogan, 'today's energy – tomorrow's warmth', sums up what it is all about: surplus renewable energy produced in the summer is stored for use in the winter by means of a thermochemical process.", "gist": "SeasON's slogan describes storing summer renewable energy for winter use via thermochemical process."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The process uses sodium hydroxide solution, which is concentrated using renewable energy or heat in summer by extracting water from it.", "gist": "The process concentrates sodium hydroxide solution in summer by removing water using renewable energy or heat."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The sodium hydroxide solution and the water can then be stored separately at room temperature without any losses until winter.", "gist": "The separated sodium hydroxide solution and water are stored at room temperature until winter without loss."}]}
